info.title: AssetOS organization and access API
info.description: Cookie authenticated API. Current organization membership and grants are resolved server-side; scopes combine by union. Protected ownership/settings, verified identity/workspaces/invitations, location/category/unit setup, catalog/opening inventory and typed private inventory attachments are implemented as described by individual operations. Later custody/purchasing/maintenance/reporting remain planned. No live provider or release acceptance is implied by this contract.

post.summary: Register an account with no memberships or permissions
post.description: Creates an unverified account and encrypted verification-mail event atomically. Returns the existing 201 {msg} response without a session, company, membership or grants. Existing account presence can still produce registration validation/conflict errors. Requires local mail/key/origin configuration; otherwise 503 and no account is created.

get.summary: Recover committed intent without repeating mutation
get.description: Current actor only. Company context supports appointOwner/removeOwner and requires current protected ownership plus ownership.manage. context=account supports requestVerification without an organization header; current identity/session must remain active. Returns the committed durable result pointer, never resends mail or repeats a mutation. Other command families remain planned. Account context now includes createWorkspace/acceptInvitation, requiring verified current account and active resulting membership. Company inviteEmployee/revokeInvitation lookup requires verified membership.manage plus access.manage. Returned references never repeat mutations. Inventory configuration commands require the current matching location.manage/category.manage/unit.manage permission. A preview pointer remains a historical result; moving still requires an unexpired unchanged preview. Catalog/inventory commands authorize the referenced resource again; replay reserializes current fields even while a response cache exists, preventing revoked cost visibility from leaking. Attachment command lookup revalidates uploader/target/financial visibility; removed-file history is visible only for an authorized removal intent.

Transactionally replaces earlier verification links and enqueues encrypted mail, unless already verified. Replaying a committed key never reissues a link even after cached response removal. Three requests per account and twenty link operations per IP per 15 minutes; 429 includes Retry-After. Mail configuration failure returns 503. Account-context command lookup is supported.

post.description: Normalized email; always the same accepted response for existing, unknown, disabled and demo accounts when mail is configured. Three requests per email and twenty link operations per IP per 15 minutes; 429 includes Retry-After. Eligible accounts receive a 30-minute one-use token; reissue revokes previous recovery tokens. Transactional enqueue; 503 when mail is unavailable. Response equality does not promise identical timing.

post.summary: Consume recovery token and revoke sessions
post.description: Public one-use recovery token consumption, password update and session-version increment in one transaction. Every earlier session (including legacy version-0 cookies) is rejected on subsequent authentication. Does not verify email, grant membership or create a session. Clears the browser token cookie. Consumed/revoked/expired/old-email links return INVALID_TOKEN (400); shared link IP throttling applies.

Stable key deduplicates one new isolated company, active membership, protected ownership and four starter roles. No existing-company access is granted. Replays authorize current membership and return current workspace data even after response-cache removal. 30 onboarding writes per account per 15 minutes.

currency.description: Null until legacy company currency is explicitly configured.

timeZone.description: Null until legacy company time zone is explicitly configured.

password.description: Also limited to 72 UTF-8 bytes; longer input is rejected rather than bcrypt-truncated.

OnboardingWorkspace.description: Creation requires known currency/timeZone. Acceptance into an existing legacy company may return null for settings awaiting review.

OnboardingGrant.description: Exactly one role or direct permission. Location scope requires locationId and currently active ancestors; department scope requires departmentCode. Other scopes prohibit these references. Current inviter authority must cover every permission and the entire proposed scope at creation and acceptance. Administrative permissions require organization scope; ownership cannot be delegated.

CatalogAttributes.description: Validated against the category field definitions; no executable expressions. No hidden cost fields allowed.

CatalogQuantity.description: Nonnegative numeric(20,6) decimal string; item unit scale may be stricter.

unitCost.description: Known opening unit cost, including explicit zero. Omission preserves unknown cost; no currency conversion.

CatalogOpeningInput.description: Verified existing stock only, never procurement receiving. Requires inventory.opening for item ownership and receiving location; known unitCost additionally requires cost.read for both. Received date uses company time zone; purchase date cannot follow receipt. Individual units require 1–200 company-unique normalized tags, one per whole quantity. Pooled/consumable entries prohibit units. Supplier/contact references are added with their implementing contact module.

CatalogWarranty.description: expiresOn is the first uncovered day. Support URL must use HTTPS without embedded credentials. Contact references remain planned with contacts.

containsCost.description: Optional financial classification. Invoice/quotation/contract categories always imply true and cannot be downgraded.
